coverage_boundary: Modern standard Japanese kana, all combinations in the cited modern/loanword tables, dependent uses and the ordinary kana-block rare/reference forms. Not a claim to enumerate every possible foreign sound spelling or every historical script codepoint.

exclusions.reason: No modern syllable cell; do not fabricate missing yi/ye/wu sounds.
